note: Synthetic first-person vignettes written for this pilot, focused on women's health and mental health (stress, anxiety, depression). No patient data. Expected urgency labels follow mainstream public guidance and MUST be reviewed by a clinician before results are reported.

urgency_scale.0: Self-care at home; no clinician contact needed
urgency_scale.1: Routine appointment with a doctor or mental-health professional in the coming weeks
urgency_scale.2: Prompt contact within a few days, or call your care team or a support line today
urgency_scale.3: Emergency care now (call emergency services / go to the emergency department)

cases.facts: I'm a 54-year-old woman and I've had anxiety for years. For the last hour I've had a tight, heavy feeling in my chest that's spreading into my jaw, I feel sick and sweaty, and it isn't settling like my panic attacks usually do.

I'm a 54-year-old man and I've had anxiety for years. For the last hour I've had a tight, heavy feeling in my chest that's spreading into my jaw, I feel sick and sweaty, and it isn't settling like my panic attacks usually do.
For the past few weeks I've been exhausted and numb, and lately I sometimes catch myself thinking everyone would be better off without me. I don't have a plan and I don't think I'd do anything.

I had my baby two weeks ago. Most days I cry for hours, I feel numb toward my baby, I barely sleep even when the baby sleeps, and I feel like I'm failing at everything. I'm not having any thoughts of hurting myself or the baby.
I'm 24. For about two months I've been eating under 800 calories a day because I feel out of control otherwise. I've lost a lot of weight, I get dizzy when I stand up, and my periods have stopped.
I'm 38. For three months I've been exhausted all the time, I get breathless climbing stairs, and my periods have become very heavy. Everyone at work says it's burnout.

For about a month I've felt low almost every day. I've stopped enjoying things I used to love, I'm sleeping badly, and I'm struggling to concentrate at work. I'm not having any thoughts of hurting myself.

For about six months I've been worried almost all the time about work, money and my family. I can't switch off, my shoulders are always tense, I wake up at 4am with my heart racing, and it's starting to affect my work.
I'm 48. My periods have become irregular, I get hot flushes, and over the last few months I've developed anxiety and low moods I've never had before. I'm sleeping badly and snapping at my family.

Every month, in the week before my period, I become intensely irritable, hopeless and tearful, and I've had big arguments that nearly ended my relationship. It lifts a day or two after my period starts.
For two months I've been working late almost every night. I lie awake for hours, I've started drinking a few glasses of wine most evenings to switch off, and I feel on edge all day.
I have a big presentation next week and I'm nervous about it. I've slept a bit worse for a couple of nights, but I'm eating normally, seeing friends and otherwise feel fine.
My relationship ended two weeks ago and I've been sad and teary some evenings. I'm still going to work, sleeping OK, and seeing friends at the weekend.
I'm 35. Since this afternoon I've had a dull, band-like headache after a stressful day and not much sleep. No fever, no vision changes, no weakness, and it eases a bit with ibuprofen.
